output.reason: The upgrade guide lists this under "Deprecated configuration options are removed" and says "`experimental.ruler.enable-api` is removed. Use `ruler.enable-api` instead." [ev-8fea3a0e7308]. The changelog says the same [ev-887b12a31841]. A configured key that is removed stops being honoured, which is what setting-ignored covers, and the remediation (switch to `ruler.enable-api`) is exactly what the guide says to do. The evidence does not say whether a leftover old key is silently dropped or stops startup. Either way it is action, so setting-ignored is the smallest kind the evidence supports, and that is why confidence is low.
